entries.title: Ask HN: What is your favorite method of sending large files?
entries.author: mettamage
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What is your favorite method of sending large files?
entries.excerpt: I just opened up a simple HTTP server to send someone a large file. Then I figured, I never gave this question proper thought. But some of you have, and I figured they make for fun and interesting stories ;-) So what's your favorite method to send large files, of at least 5GB or bigger? Though, I'm also curious on how you'd send 10TB or more.
entries.guide_zh: 临时架 HTTP 服务之外，给别人发送大文件还有什么方便可靠的方法？
